markets.rules_primary: If a completed submission by any of the 50 states of federal ballot-mail data through the USPS Federal Ballot Mail Portal is confirmed by any of the Source Agencies after Issuance and before Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency that A) explicitly states a qualifying state submission was completed, B) is based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) is presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

State means one of the 50 states. A qualifying submission requires a state or its authorized designee to complete the transfer of federal ballot-mail data through the Federal Ballot Mail Portal. Account creation, portal familiarization, design communication, optional notice, intent, planning, and a failed or incomplete upload do NOT qualify. A nonpublic portal record without a qualifying Source Agency report does NOT qualify.
markets.title: Will any state submit ballot-mail data to USPS?

markets.rules_primary: If LISA performs (or it is announced that they will perform at) the MTV Video Music Awards 2026 during the official event timeframe, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Additional clarification(s):

LISA appears on stage or in the official broadcast or stream; AND

LISA actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

Is either a scheduled performer, a guest appearance during another artist's set, or is formally announced as a performer by official event organizers or LISA's official representatives.

Note: This Contract may resolve on the announcement of LISA’s anticipated performance at MTV Video Music Awards 2026. If an announced LISA later withdraws from MTV Video Music Awards 2026, this will not affect the resolution of the Contract.

The following constitutes a performance and IS encompassed by the Payout Criterion:

A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which LISA is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which LISA performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which LISA is present and actively performing, even if LISA's portion is partial.

A performance in which LISA performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within MTV Video Music Awards 2026.

A DJ set in which LISA is the performing DJ operating equipment live, regardless of whether LISA sings.

A pre-recorded performance segment presented as part of the official event program, provided it is attributed to LISA by the official event organizers and presented as a performance (rather than a tribute, retrospective, or archival clip).

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.

A performance at a rescheduled version of MTV Video Music Awards 2026 where the reschedule occurs within one year of the original event date, pursuant to the postponement provisions below.
markets.title: Will LISA perform at MTV Video Music Awards 2026?
